status: registered before production edits; isolated development candidate, not accepted
baseline: Combined experimental source and health histogram candidate; its full native gate is pending independently.
mechanism: At a new STOP onset, require zero misses, a current cluster and recorded provenance. Preserve established near escalation only when the current cluster satisfies Tracker._near and latest provenance is ordinary or off_gauge. Otherwise retain the existing strict-gauge and bounded fresh-evidence requirements.
history_semantics: Prior keep_thin matches may contribute to near_hist. A current ordinary near match preserves that inherited near-history rule; the exception is not evidence that every prior near hit was ordinary. Current keep_thin, keep_low and far_thin never use the exception.
scope: Minimal Tracker._fresh_stop_ok correction; preserve confirmation, column/approach precedence, calibration holds and later opinion withholding.
Propose fresh_stop_evidence=true in TrackingConfig, canonical YAML and ROS YAML only in this isolated candidate. Keep all other defaults, including stop_keep_low_s=0.3, unchanged.
Preserve the original P3 experiment config and historical evidence. Earlier ride reductions do not transfer to this revised mechanism without measurement.
focused_validation: Existing ordinary advisory near escalation can report STOP; confirmation still applies.
Current continuation is rejected even with satisfied near history; mixed prior thin/current ordinary history explicitly preserves inherited semantics.
Column, untrusted range/height, low clusters and approach blocks retain precedence.
Opinion withholding, calibration holds, long gaps and STOP re-onset remain bounded.
Run affected tests and lint in resense-cycle-dev against /workspace/ReSense-onset; build the local native backend and verify its expected b5a5c2dc digest.
acceptance_after_parent_authorization: Freeze clean source/config/native hashes, then run one full native default gate against the health candidate gate: six recordings, eight ride chunks, set O and set F, with no overrides, waivers or missing/worse required metrics.
Require retained raw person/rail coverage, first/sustained O/F distances, unmatched detections and monitoring range; inspect onset and post-gap histories, event/STOP episodes and fragmentation.
Run paired processing histories and original-header ROS replay only after the full gate survives and the parent schedules compute. Retain every failure.
No acceptance, publication or score improvement is asserted by focused tests or this protocol.
